tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i gsang khrid thun mong ma yin pa 'chad tshul gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba nges don zab mo'i bcud thigs bzhugs so// rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po dang dbyer ma mchis pa bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal gnas gsar ba chen po ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sku drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa'i zhal snga nas dang / rab 'byams rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs brag rtsa rdo rje 'chang blo gsal bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ste 'gran bral rnam gnyis kyi zhabs la rnam kun phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos byang chub snying po'i bar rjes su bzung du gsol/ de la 'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas he ru ka dpal nyid gdul bya'i dbang gis rgyud gsum dregs pa'i ded dpon du bzhengs pa rgya bod mkhas grub spyi dang / bye brag rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan srung dbang po dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po 'di la brten pa'i smin grol zab cing rgya che ba bzhugs pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa mngon spyod mchog gi dngos grub tu bsgyur ba'i thabs khyad par can gsang khrid thun mong ma yin pa gdung rgyud rim pa dang / bstan 'dzin kha'u brag rdzong pa las byon pa 'di nyid kyi sgo nas snod ldan slob ma bstan 'gror phan nges pa'am lugs 'di la kha zhe med pa'i dad pa can re gnyis rjes su bzung tshul brjod par bya ste/ de yang rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing bka' srol 'di la byang chub pa zhig la/ snod ldan gyi slob ma res kyang yun ring po'i bar du gsol ba 'debs shing lus srog longs spyod 'phongs med du gtong nus pa'i snying stobs can la/ bla ma dang chos skyong la gnang ba zhu zhing dge ba'i mtshan ma mthong ba dang /

snod min gyi skye bos dben pa'i ri khrod byin rlabs can nam/ bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa/ mgon khang khyad par can nam rang gi sgrub khang dben zhing 'khos phebs su zla ba gang rung gi brgyad gnyis dang / bcu gnyis la mer dbang phyug gi 'grub sbyor sogs gza' skar drag cing bzang bar gur gyi mgon po lha dgu'i rjes gnang rdo rje dbang phyug rab brtan gyi gsung rab bzhin la zhal 'phang rnams tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung gtor bsngo phrin las myur mgyogs dang / rje dbang phyug rab brtan gyi gsung gur zhal rnam gnyis kyi rjes gnang gcig shes kun grol rnams lhu bsgrig la bla ma dam pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin gyi bgos bka' phyin nas khrid ston pa la bku bag can gyi zlum gtor pad 'dab bzhi skor rtse dang dkyil du sgor rgyun can stegs bu khebs ldan 'bru bkram pa'i khar bshams drung chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod rnams bshams/ gtor ma nyer mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ gu gul sogs spos gtsang mas bdug slob ma rnams 'du gong slob dpon gyis srung 'khor brag rdzong ma'i rdzas la gsang khrid bsgom tshul tshar chen rje'i brag rdzong ma'i yi ge bzhin la dmigs pa spong zhing bsgom bzlas yongs rdzogs grub pa dang / slob ma bos la phyag dang gral la 'khod 'phral slob dpon gyis/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / dpon slob lhan du/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhes sogs tshar nyer gcig thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma bdag ni sogs nas/ rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur bar/ kye rdor lam dus kyi dbu bzhin 'di la bskyed chog med kyang bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung 'di kho na yin pas dpon slob rnams kyi bsgom don yang lam dus sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin nges par bsam dgos shing / khyad par 'og nas rim bzhin ston par 'gyur ba'i dmigs rim zab mo rnams bsgom pa la gegs su gyur pa thams cad sbyong ba'i 'dun pa drag po bya'o/

/slob dpon nam gzhan gang rung gis bskul la/ tshar chen rje'i gsung gur mgon brgyud 'debs rnam kun mchog ldan ma gdangs ma'am med kyang rung bas gsang khrid brgyud pa'i zhal skong bcas byas la/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma 'bul bar dri bzang gis brlan bcas byas la/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bka' khrid zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes sogs 'dra/ de'i bar la slob dpon gyis mchod gtor oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya staṃ/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya ma hā kā li de wī e ka dza ṭi de wī sa pā ri wa ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis gtor ma phul/ sngags shams su ar+ghaṃ sogs dang 'bru gsum btags pa'i phyi nang gi mchod/ srin po'i gzugs kyis sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang / gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi sogs sh+lau ka gcig dpal ldan mgon po lcam bral rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen kun sel mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /zhes brjod/ gshegs gsol mi mdzad/ zhwa yod na gyon/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje dang / 'khor ba las sgrol 'dod kyi nga rgyal brtan pos lus drang por bsrangs shing / mig zim bur blta bas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ ༈ /'o ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang sku tshe 'di nyid la thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab pa las kyang ches zab par gyur pa/

theg pa chen po'i dam pa'i chos gsan la thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa la sogs pa dang / thugs bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa legs par gsal btab ste gsan pa dang / chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa thams cad kyang rgyud sde rin po che dri ma med pa rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin du sku lus kyi 'dug stangs kyang drang por gnas pa dang / thugs kyi bsam pas gnas khang yang tha mal gyi snang ba 'di lta bu ma yin te/ dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ da ltar rdo rje slob dpon kyang tha mal gyi snang ba 'di lta bu ma yin te/ seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma mi ro dmar ser gyi gdan gyi steng na bzhugs pa'i dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po dngos yin snyam pa dang / khyed rang rnams kyang lhag pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas chos kyi sgra dbyangs skye ba med pa sgrogs pa srid zhi'i rgud pa thams cad sel bar byed pa'i sgra lhang lhang yod snyam pa'i ngang nas gsal stong 'dzin pa ma mchis pa'i ngang nas yengs med kyi tshul du gsan par zhu/ de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi phyag tu dpal rdo rje sogs 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi gsung rab gsang sgrub kyi zin bris bka' rgya can nas 'byung ba bzhin kho rang gi ngo bo la bzo med du 'jog par byed do bar skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa 'phog yang na mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig bzhin skyabs sems kyi khrid bya/ re zhig 'dir skyabs khrid rkyang pa'i dbang du byas nas/ de nas sems bskyed sogs brag rdzong ma lta bu nyams su len bzhin pa yin na shar gyi bya/

min na de las byung ba'i dge ba sems can gyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par gyur cig snyam pas/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun sogs dang / bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid sogs bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab nas thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug dgos pas slar yang nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ de la 'dir bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sogs nas/ tshig nyung bar 'dod na 'byin 'jug skabs su gang babs blos dpyad dge ba bsngo ba'i bar bya/ slar yang zhes sogs gong bzhin bskyar la 'jug dgos pas do nub kyi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa de la mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la gyes/ slob ma rnams kyis de'i dgongs thun dang / srod thun sang nas bzung thor snga dgong srod kyi thun khrid ma tshar gyi bar byas la sems bskyed sogs rim bzhin ston par 'gyur ba'i dmigs pa rnams spo zhing myong ba thon par bsgom mo/ /'on kyang snyan brgyud bzhi sogs kyi bshad pa rnams mkhyen brtse'i gsung de nyid skyabs sems sogs kyi khrid rnams la bgo bsha' byas nas 'chad par ltar nas/ dper brjod ni nyin dang por de la 'dir bstan pa'i mnga' bdag zhes pa nas/ snyan brgyud kyi ming btags pa yin gsung bar/ de la 'dir snyan brgyud gnyis pa 'di nyid la'ang / gdul bya dbang po rno 'bring rab kyi dbye bas rnam gzhag gsum 'byung ba las/ 'dir phyi ma ltar 'chad pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las zhes sogs dang sbrel nas skyabs 'gro'i khrid bya/ de'i sang kha sang byas pa de'i bar 'dra/ gdul bya dbang po rtul po zhes pa nas/ skyabs 'gro'i khrid kyi bzo med du 'jog par byed do bar byas la/ gnyis pa sems bskyed nas/ zhes pa nas/ ched du 'jog par byed do bar/ sems bskyed dang yig brgya'i khrid lhan cig tu bya ba'am/ yang na sems bskyed rkyang pa'i khrid/

rjes bsdu tshul dang / bskyar chos gang gi rigs 'gre 'og ma thams cad la bya ba yin pas/ slar yang nges par bya ba'i slad du da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ de la 'dir dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ snyan brgyud bzhi'i nang tshan snyan brgyud gnyis pa 'di nyid la yang zhes sogs nas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bzhi las/ dang po ni kha sang song ba ltar bya/ gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ zhes sogs/ rigs 'gre rang yin zhing / mjug gi bsngo ba dmigs thun so so'i rjes ma de la byed pas/ sems bskyed dang yig brgya sbrel na rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyi rjes dang / sems bskyed rkyang pa yin na de'i rjes la bya'o/ /de bzhin du sang de yang bskyar chos gong bzhin/ bzhi pa bla ma'i sogs nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma gtso bor 'bul/ de yang dngul sogs rin po che'am/ li dang 'khar ba sogs las byas pa'i maṇ+ḍal mtho skor las mi chung ba dang / nas 'bras sogs 'bru 'bun med dngos gtsang ci 'byor/ dri bzang gi chu dung chos sogs snod ji ltar rigs par bshams/ maṇ+ḍal der thog ma nas dbus su gnas srung tshom bu nyung ngu bkod pa 'bul ba'i tshe der dri bzang gi chu thigs gcig blugs/ rang gi lag g.yas kyis mtheb srin sbyar bas chu 'bru bu dang bcas pa dbus nas byang shar du 'then la/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐ sogs brjod cing gru bzhi bris/ phyi lcags ri zhes sogs brjod tshe maṇ+ḍal gyi mtha' bskor zlum ris dri chu de nyid kyis bya/ de nas tshom bu rnams rim bzhin bkod nas 'bul ba yin pas ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang / bzhes nas bdag gi brgyud la rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin bzang po ma skyes pa bskyed pa/

skyes pa brtan pa/ brtan pa gnas pa/ gnas pa mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ 'byor pa che zhing spros pa la dga' na/ tshar ji 'bul thams cad la tshom nas brjes/ yang na de nyid kha gsos la 'bul/ mthar spro na so bdun ma dang / zhes pa nas gal che gsung bar/ slar yang nges par bya ba'i sogs/ de la 'dir dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i snyan brgyud kyi sogs nas/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po la skyabs sems rdor sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams las bzhi pa bla ma'i nas gal che gsung bar/ slar yang sogs/ de nas thun las ldang bar 'dod na brag rdzong ma shar bsgom bya'am/ yang na bsngo smon gyi blo gsal btab la/ skye ba kun tu yang dag sogs ci shes bya dgos pas/ do nub kyi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa de la mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs so/ /de bzhin du yang bskyar chos 'dra/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ zhes pa nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang bar/ skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhes sogs nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa bar/ mngon rtogs blo la byang ba zhig gis gsal btab pas chog 'on kyang 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi khrid sogs las 'di ltar gsungs te/ thun mong ba'i bsrung ba'i zhes pa nas nges shes bskyed pa'i bar byas nas sems 'dzin rnams rim pas ston na/ slar yang nges par bya ba'i sogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs kyis bskyar chos tshar gnyis/ thun las ldang ba sogs 'dra/ sang skyar chos dang / rnam pa spyi la sems bzung ba ni/ gur gyi mgon po nas/ dngos yin snyam du sems bzung gi bar/

rnam pa bye brag la sems bzung ba la/ rgyan med la sems bzung ba dang / rgyan can la sems bzung ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang nyid mgon po nas/ rgyan med la sems 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar/ rje mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig brag rdzong ma bzhin/ slar yang nges pa sogs bskyar chos 'gre/ de'i sang bskyar chos tshar nas/ rgyan can la sems bzung ba ni phyag g.yas rdo rje zhes pa nas/ res 'jog tu sems bzung bar phyi khrid bzhin/ gong du bshad pa'i nas bzla bar byed bar gsang khrid kyi yi ge bzhin bskyar chos sogs rigs 'gre/ 'di ni sngar nas khrid la goms cha cher med pa rnams la byed lugs yin/ sngar brag rdzong ma'i phyi khrid thob cing goms cha yod na bskyed rim sems 'dzin bcas sdeb gcig la byas kyang chog go /de'i sang bskyar chos tshar nas gnyis pa brten pa rdzogs pa'i nas/ ldog pa'i cha nas gsum yin la bar/ skabs 'dir dregs pa rgyud gsum du ma 'dus pa'i chos ni til 'bru tsam yang med pas/ de dag gi rnam gzhag rim pas ston pa'i dbang du byas nas/ de mngon du byed pa'i thabs lam dbri bskyed nyams len gyi gnad la bsnyen sgrub las gsum las/ dang po bsnyen pa la zhes pa nas/ bla ma dang yum chen dran tsam byed bar bskyar chos la rgyas pa ltar na gong bzhin/ bsdu na gnyis pa brten zhes pa nas ring thung 'tshams pa'i lam zhes bya ba 'di la gzhi skye med ces pa nas/ zhes bya ba dang gsum las bar/ gzhi ni 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang sems las logs na med pas de nyid dregs pa rgyud gsum yin par ngo sprad nas de mngon du byed pa'i thabs bsnyen sgrub/ zhes sogs gong bzhin no/ /de'i sang bskyar chos kyi til 'bru tsam yang med par 'dra/ de dag kyang rang sems zhes pa nas/ dgongs pa yang de yin gsung bar/ de mngon du sogs nas bla ma dang yum chen dran byed par/ yang yum chen las nas/ lha bsdu ba sogs mi gsung ngo bar/

bskyar chos rgyas bsdus ci rigs/ sang gi bskyar chos las de yin gsung bar 'dra/ des na rdo rje'i lus la nas/ rlung rnams su grub la bar/ de mngon du nas ji ltar bsgom tshul ni bar rang gi snying kha'i 'od kyis bla ma yi dam chos skyong spyan drangs nas thim pa'i rkyen gyis rtsa gsum gsal 'debs nas/ bla ma dang yum chen bde ba bsgrub pa'i bar dang / yang yum chen las sogs nas mi gsung ngo bar/ de nas lus kyi nas de ltar gsal btab pa'i rjes su bar/ zangs gri can thabs gsal ba'i rang bzhin des yum chen shes rab stong pa'i rang bzhin la zhes sogs bde ba bsgrub pa'i dmigs tshig rnams gong bzhin de bzhin 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre sbyar la ci rigs pa zhig bya'o bar/ bskyar chos rgyas bsdus ci rig sang gi bskyar chos rlung rnams su grub la bar/ de dag dregs pa nas 'di yin la bar 'di la bsnyen sgrub las gsum las/ dang po bsnyen pa nas thung mong gi bsnyen pa ni bskyed rim bzlas pa yod med gang rung gi mthar rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bla ma yi dam chos skyong spyan drangs nas thim pa'i rkyen gyis rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga yum chen dang bla ma bsgom zhing bde ba bsgrub pa/ mgon po lcam dral bsgom zhing bde ba bsgrub pa sogs byas la/ de nas las kyi zhes sogs nas ci rigs pa zhig bya'o bar de'ang lha nas pu tra 'di gshin rje dang rgyal po thams cad kyi gtso bo yin pas so/ /zhes gsung bar/ bskyar chos rgyas bsdus ci rigs/ sang gi bskyar chos la 'di yin la bar/ 'di dpa' bo g.yul nas thung mong gi bsnyen pa ni bar/ bskyed rim bzlas pa yod med zhes pa nas/ lcam dral bsgom zhing bde ba bsgrub pa bar/ las mkhan rnams bsgom zhing bde ba bsgrub pa'i bar bya/ de'ang lha nas yin pas so zhes gsung bar/ de ltar dngos nyams nas/ mi 'khu ba'i bzlas pa bya ba sogs bar yin pas/

bskyar chos bsdu na/ gnyis pa rten zhes pa nas/ ngo sprad nas de mngon du byed pa'i thabs lam dbri bskyed nyams len gyi gnad la dpa' bo g.yul du 'jug pa'i dgra thabs bsnyen sgrub las gsum las/ dang po bsnyen pa la thun mong dang thun mong min pa gnyis las/ thun mong gi bsnyen pa'i bar sngon du song ba bzhin dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i bsnyen pa'i nas/ bya ba sogs yin pas bar/ sang gi bskyar chos 'dra/ mi 'khu ba'i bzlas pa bya ba ni zhes pa nas/ de las gsang rten lus sba gong bzhin byed bar/ bskyar chos gong bzhin la thun mong ma yin pa'i bsnyen pa las mgrin pa'i dmigs pa yan sngon du song ba bzhin dang / mi 'khu ba'i sogs bskyar chos 'dra/ sang gi bskyar chos gong bzhin de ltar byas kyang nas sngar bzhin byed bar bskyar chos 'gre/ sang gi bskyar chos gong bzhin/ des kyang cung zad 'tshubs na nas zung 'jug gi rang ngo sprod pa'i bar/ man ngag yin no/ /bskyar chos 'gre/ sang gi bskyar chos gong bzhin/ de yan chad kyis thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i bsnyen pa'i dmigs gnad rnams legs par bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa rbad ba'am bsgrub pa'i zhes pa nas/ de yi dbang du mdzad pa yin/ zhes gsung bar/ 'dir lte ba'i nas rlung gi rnal 'byor sgom par byed pa las bar/ 'dir thog mar las dang po pa nas/ grangs mnyam por bya ba nas byin gyis brlab pa'o bar/ tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas nyams su len dgos pas thun gyi mthar las mkhan myang 'das nas gsang rten sba ba'i bar sngar lte bar bsgom skabs bzhin yin pas/ bskyar chos rigs 'gre sang gi bskyar chos gong bzhin/ de yan chad kyis thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i bsnyen pa'i dmigs gnad rnams legs par bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa rbad pa'am bsgrub pa'i zhes pa nas/ de yi dbang du mdzad pa yin/ zhes gsung bar/ 'dir lte ba'i nas rlung gi rnal 'byor sgoms par byed pa las bar/

'dir thog mar las dang po pa nas/ grangs mnyam por bya ba nas byin gyis brlab pa'o bar/ tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas nyams su len dgos pas thun gyi mthar gyi mthar las mkhan myang 'das nas gsang rten sba ba'i bar sngar lte bar bsgom skabs bzhin yin pas/ bskyar chos rigs 'gre/ sang gi bskyar chos las/ de'i dbang du mdzad pa yin zhes gsung bar/ gang la gnad du nas/ sgom par byed pa las bar/ 'di la gsung sgros nas byin gyis brlab pa'o bar/ yang yum chen nas bsgrub pa mthar phyin pa'o bar/ tshul de lta bu'i sogs/ bskyar chos la gnyis pa bsgrub pa'am rbad pa'i man ngag gang la gnad du sogs gong bzhin/ sang gi bskyar chos kyang de nyid la gegs sel sogs snying kha dang / mgrin pa'i dmigs pa phog bskyar chos ni gnyis pa bsgrub pa'am rbad pa'i man ngag rlung sngags zung 'jug gi nyams len las thog mar lte ba nas 'go bzung ba yan song nas/ de la gegs sel snying kha dang mgrin par bsgom tshul gong bzhin no/ /sang gi bskyar chos/ de la 'dir dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i man ngag tshad ma snyan brgyud bzhi ldan las/ snyan brgyud gnyis pa 'di la phyi nang gsang ba'i man ngag gi gnad bzhugs pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa gsang ba yang tig sems la brten nas bsgrub pa 'di la/ gzhi skye med dngos po'i gnas lugs/ lam dbri bskyed nyams len gyi gnad mthar thug bstan pa bsrung ba'i mtshon char gtad nas mngon spyod mchog gi dngos grub tu bsgyur ba rnams las/ lam dbri bskyed nyams len gyi gnad la dpa' bo g.yul du 'jug pa'i dgra thabs gsum mam lnga sbyong byed bsnyen bsgrub las gsum las/ dang po bsnyen pa la thun mong gi bsnyen pa sngon 'gro'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bsnyen pa mi 'khu ba'i bzlas pa/ srog 'phrog pa'i bzlas pa/ srog gi yang tig blang ba'i bzlas pa rnams 'khor lo lnga la brten pa'i gnad khyad par can du song nas/

gnyis pa bsgrub pa'am rbad pa la rnam gzhag rags pa sngon du btang nas nyams len dngos lte ba nas bzung bya dgos pa'ang sngon du bstan pa ltar yin cing / de la gegs sel sogs snying mgrin dmigs pa bskyar/ spyi bo dang gsang gnas kyi dmigs pa phog bskyar chos dang / sang gi bskyar chos gong bzhin la de la gegs sel snying mgrin gyi dmigs pa gong du bstan pa ltar dang / spyi gsang gi dmigs pa bskyar la de yan chad kyis bsgrub pa'am rbad pa'i dmigs pa rnams ma tshang ba med pa song nas/ gsum pa la nas gsung bzhin du shes par bya'o bar/ bskyar chos la de la 'dir nag po chen po'i man ngag gsang ba yang tig sems la brten pa la bsnyen bsgrub las gsum las/ bsnyen bsgrub gnyis gong du rgyas par bstan zin nas gsum pa las la sogs gong bzhin/ sang gi bskyar chos 'dra/ de las thun mong min pa'i dmigs pa mi ston na rgyun du nyams su len tshul bshad nas grol ba yin la/ ston pa ltar na/ de nas gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i las sbyor las spyi bo'i dmigs pa nas bzung / bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom pa'i bar tshar chen rje'i gsung bzhin thun re bcad nas bsgom du 'jug pa yin pas bskyar chos rigs 'gre/ snying kha chos 'khor la dmigs thun gnang srol ma bzhugs shing / lung dang phyag len ni bzhugs so/ /gang ltar de lta bu'i khrid yongs rdzogs phog nas rgyun gyi nyams len tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung phyi'i brag rdzong ma'i nyams len gyi rjes su gsungs pa ltar la bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor rnams skabs su gang babs gnas skabs de dang der nyams su len pa yin pas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos sogs gsang khrid thun mong ma yin pa gsan pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/

zhes dang / slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma 'bul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus longs spyod zhes sogs spyi 'gre'i deng nas brtsam ste lan gsum/ de rnams kyi sgo nas gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams la rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi nyams bzhes gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras tshogs slob sogs zab cing rgya che ba'i bka' srol du ma bzhugs pa'i nang nas snying por gyur pa bstan srung dpal nag po chen po che chung la'ang mkhas grub gzhan las zab khyad che ba'i gdams pa rdo rje 'chang nas bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa du ma zhig las mchog tu gyur pa dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i man ngag gsang ba yang tig sems la brten pa'i skor yongs su rdzogs pa phul zin pa yin pas rang nyid kyi nyams len snying por bya zhing / bstan pa 'dzin nges pa'am bka' srol 'di la snying nas dad pa thob cing / bla med rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams su dbang gis rgyud smin/ khyad par 'di'i smin grol go rim bzhin thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i snod ldan slob ma yin nges ma gtogs bab col ci thod thod la mi ster ba sogs dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du mdzad pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ bsngo smon bkra shis ci rigs bya'o/ /zhes dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i gsang khrid kyi sgo nas snod ldan rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshul 'di yang rje btsun sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud bstan pa'i bdag po tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ste 'gran bral yab sras de gnyis kyi gsung rab la gsal byed gang dgos byed dgos zhes sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la/

dpal sa skya'i zur 'chad sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa rin chen rgyal mtshan nas bskul ma mdzad pa bzhin 'chad tshul nyung ngu 'di bzhin bris pa yin zhing / rgyas par khog phub kyi bshad pa byed tshe 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi bstan srung chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin rnam dpyod shin tu yangs pos sbyar zhing / nyams len dmigs thun rnams ni re re la myong thon bsgom du 'jug pa'i gong du bshad pa sogs 'phral lugs sna tshogs bya ba las mtha' gcig tu ma nges pas de bzhin shes dgos/ 'di yis bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig/ //bkra shis shog 'di'i ljags lung zur 'chad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan zhabs drung du bdag sangs rgyas dpal 'byor gyis nos lags so/ /bdag gi sug rjes so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gur gyi mgon po'i gsang khrid thun min 'chad tshul gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
